title: Qahwa DocType
description: A DocType: one kind of document, from which Qahwa makes the table, the API and the screens.

allowCopy.description: False hides "Duplicate" for this DocType (people can still create documents).

allowRename.description: Documents may be renamed, or merged into another, by people who can write them.

autoname.description: How document names are generated: "hash" (default), "prompt" (caller supplies it), "field:<fieldname>", or a series pattern such as "CUST-.#####".

defaultView.description: The view a person lands on the first time they open this DocType in a session: list (the default), tree, board, calendar, gallery, map or timeline.

allowOnSubmit.description: Submittable DocTypes: the field may still be changed after the document is submitted.

bold.description: The label is shown in bold on the form.

dependsOn.description: Expression: the field is only shown (and only required) while this is true.

description.description: Help text shown under the field in forms.

fetchFrom.description: "link_field.target_field": copy a value from the document a Link field points at.

fetchIfEmpty.description: With FetchFrom: only copy the value while this field is still empty.

formula.description: Expression: the value is calculated from other fields every time the document is saved.

hidden.description: UI hint: the field is not shown in forms (its value is kept and still validated).

inPreview.description: When a document of this DocType is chosen in a Link field, a small preview card offers this field's value (ADR-116).

inStandardFilter.description: The field is offered in the list's filter sidebar (Select, Link, Check, Data, Email, Phone, Int and Rating fields).

indexed.description: Create a database index on this field (for fields that are searched or joined on).

lowercase.description: Convert text values to lower case when saving (used for emails).

mandatoryDependsOn.description: Expression: the field is required while this is true, in addition to Required.

maxLength.description: A text field refuses values longer than this many characters (1 to 10000).

multiSelect.description: Table fields only: the child DocType has just one Link field and the Desk shows the rows as a list of chips to pick from (several documents of one DocType, each at most once) instead of a grid.

noCopy.description: The value is not copied when a document is duplicated, amended or repeated.

nonNegative.description: A number field refuses values below zero.

options.description: Link target DocType, child DocType for Table, or newline-separated Select options.

permLevel.description: Permission level 0 to 9. Level 0 fields follow the DocType's ordinary access; a higher level is only visible and editable to roles that have a permission rule at that level.

precision.description: The decimals a Float, Decimal, Currency or Percent value keeps (0 to 9): longer values are rounded, halves away from zero, when saved.

readOnly.description: UI hint: the field is shown but cannot be edited in forms.

readOnlyDependsOn.description: Expression: UI hint, the field cannot be edited while this is true.

renamedFrom.description: Designer only: the name this field had before. When the DocType is saved the saved column (and its data) is renamed to Name instead of a new empty column being added. It is never kept in the stored definition.

setOnce.description: Once the field has a value it cannot be changed (it can still be filled in the first time).

translatable.description: The value is shown through the Translation documents of the person's language, like a label (Data, Select, Text and Autocomplete fields).

imageField.description: The image field (of type Image) the gallery shows by default.

indicators.description: The colour of each value of StatusField; values not listed are grey.

isSingle.description: One document only, named after the DocType (settings pages). It has no list and cannot be deleted.

isTree.description: Documents form a tree through TreeParentField and TreeGroupField.

maxAttachments.description: The most files one document may have (1 to 50); empty means the system limit of 50.

cancel.description: Submittable DocTypes: may cancel a submitted document (docstatus 1 to 2).

ifOwner.description: Restrict this rule to documents the user owns.

import.description: May import documents from a file, share a document, print it and email about it. These default to true (so a rule written before they existed changes nothing); they only take away what the role's other rights would allow, and are ignored for people with no rule for the DocType (see PermFlag).

permLevel.description: The permission level of fields this rule covers (0 is the document itself and its ordinary fields).

report.description: May use grouped reports over the documents.

submit.description: Submittable DocTypes: may submit a draft (docstatus 0 to 1).

searchFields.description: Text fields (up to 5) that picking a document in a Link field also searches, besides the name and the title.

sortDescending.description: True (the default) sorts the default sort from highest to lowest.

sortField.description: How the list is sorted until the person chooses otherwise: "name", "modified", "creation" or one of the DocType's fields. Empty means last modified first.

statusField.description: The field whose value is shown as a coloured status in lists (usually a Select such as Status).

trackChanges.description: Keep an updates log (a Version row per change, in the same transaction). On unless a DocType opts out.

trackViews.description: Keep a View Log: who opened each document and when (shown to the people who may change it).

field.description: The field to show the message under; without it the message applies to the document.
